in_sanskrit.name: Angat
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Powerful, Strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Angat एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Angat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Angah' which means body, strength and power. It is also a name of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring strength and courage to the bearer.
